item.title: Wajima Grand Festival: Giant Lantern Floats Through the Streets — Guide
item.description: Wajima Grand Festival, held each August, is the city’s largest annual celebration, featuring massive illuminated kiriko lantern floats, some standing over ten metres tall, carried and paraded through the streets by teams of local residents in a display of coordinated effort and community pride. The festival is part of the broader kiriko lantern tradition found throughout the Noto Peninsula, and Wajima’s version draws particularly large crowds given its status as the region’s biggest port town and the sheer scale of its illuminated floats.
